name: chainproof-ai
description: ChainProof AI — IP ownership verification with blockchain, IPFS, and AI similarity detection

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n chain,backend,frontend -c yellow,blue,green "npm run node -w blockchain" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:stack: concurrently -n ai,backend,frontend -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w blockchain && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
